Disgaea 4 is the fourth main game in the strategy RPG series Disgaea. The purpose of this guide is to list item locations for the Main Story, Mt. Ordeal, Post Game and X-Dimension incase you are looking for a particular item for your Data Shop, unless noted any item carried can potentially be of any rarity (Common, Rare or Legendary). If any unique enemies appear on a map they will be listed first followed by the normal enemies that appear, if a map has different enemies from the first time it is done they will be listed separately. Endings will also be listed with a link to a YouTube video incase you want to see the ending again. Chara World Evilities normally learned by all classes are listed incase you are looking for a particular one from the large assortment of evilities the game has.

Note some enemies can't be caught at all which are denoted in-game by a gold S on a green diamond (written as <S> in this guide before there name) above their name, this also includes having the DLC character Tyrant Valvatorez with the No Life King Evility, make note of that if a unit you want to capture appears from Item World Enemy Base. Additionally if you do not have the tier of the class you will fail regardless, this includes having Valvatorez at a lower level than the unit you are trying to capture.

If you find any mistakes feel free to notify me (Chara World Evilities of DLC characters would be appreciated).

X-Dimension

To unlock the X-Dimension maps you will need to find two different Cu Sith Scalpers in the Item World Mystery Gates one on floors 1-49 and the other on 51-99. Each will sell Promotionhell Tickets which unlock X-Dimension stages. Unlike Disgaea 3 you are free to sell the Tickets as the X-Dimension maps will stay open as long as you have gotten the ticket once, you do not need to keep them in a new cycle if you don't want them.

Unlocking Land of Carnage

Unlocking the Land of Carnage in Disgaea 4 takes a bit more work compared to Disgaea 3. First you must have a completion total of at least 40% from the X-Dimension maps, on top of that you will need to get the parts needed to build P Flonzor X which must be obtained via capturing enemies except for one part. Note you need P Flonzor X parts if you get G or U you will need to recapture the enemy unit again until you get P (Keep those parts to add to your collection to increase your chance to obtain P).

Part Enemy Stage found
Body Meowkins Pirates Floor 91-99 in the Item World. (Must defeat for part)
Head Professor (T5) X-Swarming Malice (X10-1)
Rear Rifle Demon (T2) Sign of Demolition (9-6)
Left Side Death (T6) X-Busted Mythology (X7-3)
Right Side Prinny (T5) X-Overlord's Test (X7-6)
Top Magic Knight (T5) X-Swarming Malice (X10-1)

User Slayer Weapons

User Slayers are weapons that will increase in certain stats as you kill other player pirates while the character who dealt the killing blow is equipped with it (Enemy or Neutral will count), you can only have one of each of these weapons (outside of duping with the Puppy Paw Stick) and the only way to get them is from capturing and interrogating specific enemies of at least Level 5000. These are treated as rank 40 items in terms of enemy strength in the Item World and the Item God on floor 100 will have the weapon you entered at a varying Rarity, these can only be Legendary.

Chara World Evilities

All characters have a finite amount of Evilities they can learn from going through their Chara World. You have a chance of finding Ability Spheres based on how much of the floor you break, though slim it is possible to find more than one Ability Sphere in a run. Note DLC character will not be mentioned (sans Asagi HD & Nisa) so in case of Flonne it refers to Archangel Flonne not Fallen Angel Flonne.

Power Leveling

Feel under powered and need a character to gain levels quickly? Certain maps can be done to gain levels quickly to help boost your characters that need an edge in levels.

5-2 Lost Dignity The map consists of 4 Nekomatas, Hell Hounds, Cockatrices & Nemophilas each in a two by two formation. At Enemy Rank 8 they will all be Level 99 which will give experience given from this is equal to a level 323. The key to leveling is having a unit with at least 8 Movement that can reach the Yellow Geo Block in the lower right corner from the Base Panel and lift it from the lower corner (to not attract a Hell Hound) then throw it onto a Purple panel and destroy the block which covers the field in a EXP +150% effect. The downside to this stage is due to the setup the Economic Stimulus Act bill counts the block as the first kill thus not granting the unit you want to level with the triple EXP benefit.

9-4 Concrete Knowledge The repeated version map consists of 2 lines of 5 Champinions slightly apart from each other. At enemy Rank 1 they will all be Level 99. You may look at the formation and wonder how to finish this map in one attack? Answer Giant Descos Yog Sothoth (learned at Level 100). In terms of leveling you won't gain levels as fast as the stage mentioned above this, but you will finish much faster and with units that have at least 5 Throw you can throw the Geo Blocks onto the Aqua panels straight ahead of it. Also since you are fusing a monster unit with Desco you are essentially leveling 2 units at a time, if your Desco doesn't do enough to kill them in one shot then surround her with allies until she is able to do it by herself with the monster that fused with her. This is a good spot to grind till the stage mentioned below, specially if you have monster units you need their higher class tiers for capturing.

Mt. Ordeal 4 The map features 13 Balrogs set in a diamond formation, the key to leveling here is with the use of Giant Magichange. You will need Fusion Weapon Lab and Dual Dojo Evil Symbols unlocked which can give 1 humanoid and up to 4 monsters equal exp per kill. To unlock them you must defeat a level 100 enemy with a giant monster (Fusion Weapon Lab) and defeat a level 1000 enemy with a Magichange (Dual Dojo), you can use a Custom map if needed. If you don't want to make your own custom map you can use Akumajis map (very end of the list by strength ranking) to get your desired Evil Symbol from the Carmilla, Cath Palug & Alraune in the closest row. Note the monster units you want to use for Dual/Giant/Dual Giant Magichange must be in both Evil Symbols not the humanoid units.

Method of leveling based on weapon Fist Giant Magichange Fist (Cu Sith or Nekomata) Skill: Big Bang

Sword Giant Magichange Sword (Desco, Orc, Dragon or Succubus) with a Magichanged Rifle Demon (Normal or Giant) Skills: Rune Dimension + Parallel Cannon Leave 1 panel free between you and the front most Balrog and use Giant Rune Dimension, then aim Parallel Cannon at the center to hit the two missed.

Spear Giant Magichange Spear (Sludge, Skeletal Dragon or Cockatrice) Skill: Meteor Shower Have an ally defeat the center most Balrog then throw your Spear user there and use Giant Meteor Shower.

Bow Giant Magichange Bow (Prinny, Zombie or Death) with another Magichange weapon (for second command) Skills: Doppelganger + Galaxy Comet Aim for the center most Balrog with Giant Doppelganger then target the rest with Giant Galaxy Comet.

Gun Giant Magichange Gun (Prinny Kurtis, Mothman, Rifle Demon or Catsaber) with another Magichange weapon (for second command) Skills: Prism Burster (Secret skill) + Deadly Down Under Aim Giant Prism Burster at the front most Balrog, then aim Giant Deadly Down Under at the center to hit the four missed.

Staff Giant Magichange Raspberyl with another Magichange weapon (for second command) Skills: Delta Extreme + Magic Area 7 Stand in front of the front most Balrog and use Giant Delta Extreme, then aim an Area 7 Magic at the center to hit the two missed.

Universal Giant Magichange Raspberyl with a Magichanged Rifle Demon (Normal or Giant) Skills: Delta Extreme + Parallel Cannon Stand in front of the front most Balrog and use Giant Delta Extreme, then aim Parallel Cannon at the center to hit the two missed.
